reason: The cited lines describe a read-only Sentry event/replay search tool requiring event:read scope and returning datasets such as errors with stack traces, application logs, spans, metrics, profiles, and replays; that establishes access to non-public SaaS data via Sentry credentials, so SECRET is supported. The lines show no arbitrary host code execution. They also show no capability to send agent-supplied data to an attacker-chosen/readable destination; querying Sentry via a fixed service is not a SINK. Although Sentry events/logs/replays may in practice contain user- or attacker-controlled content, the cited lines alone do not establish attacker control of returned content, so UNTRUSTED is insufficient.
